title: Reimbursement of an Out-of-Network Vision Plans Claim Settled on Its Glasses Part
content:
**Claims adjudication rule — Vision Plans, member-filed out-of-network claims (glasses part)**

**§1 The claim and its side.** The member's new out-of-network claim is one claim number of the enrollment whose lines are at providers without a Cascade agreement and carry no remark yet, the latest received such claim first. Which rule settles it is fixed by its receipts alone, whatever either rule's amounts: when the retail charges of its spectacle-lens and frame lines together are at least the retail charges of its contact-lens and contact-lens fitting lines together, it is settled on its glasses part under the glasses claim rule; otherwise it is settled on its contact-lens part under the contact-lens claim rule.

| Retail charges on the claim (hypothetical) | Rule that settles it |
|---|---|
| Spectacle lenses 212.00 and frame 148.00; contact lenses 190.00 and fitting 95.00 | Glasses part (360.00 against 285.00) |
| Spectacle lenses 118.00; contact lenses 176.00 and fitting 64.00 | Contact-lens part (118.00 against 240.00) |
| Glasses and contact-lens receipts equal | Glasses part |
| A routine exam only | Glasses part (0.00 against 0.00) |

A claim settled on its contact-lens part is not settled under this rule, which records nothing for it (0.00 under this rule). The claim's date of service and received date are those of its lines; each line's receipt is its retail charge; the patient's age is counted in whole years from the enrollee's date of birth to the date of service.

**§2 Coverage.** The claim is reimbursed only when the enrollment is active or terminated, and the date of service is on or after its coverage effective date and on or before its termination date when it has one. Otherwise its lines are denied as not eligible and nothing is reimbursed.

**§3 No benefit.** These lines are denied as not covered, and nothing is reimbursed for them:
- a lens line on a plan with no spectacle-lens benefit;
- a contact-lens or fitting line on a plan with no contact-lens benefit, or one that does not cover medically necessary contacts in network.

**§4 Frequency.** Each line other than the fitting is reimbursed only when the benefit of its kind is available again. The frequencies are the plan's exam frequency for a routine exam; the lens frequency, or the child lens frequency for a patient under 19, for the lenses; the frame frequency for the frame; and the contact-lens frequency for the contact lenses. The benefit is available again unless the latest service of that kind of the enrollment whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid blocks it:
- *Benefit-year basis:* a 12-month frequency is blocked by a latest service in the same benefit period, and a 24-month frequency by one in the same or the preceding benefit period. A latest service in a later period blocks nothing.
- *From-last-service basis:* the benefit is blocked when fewer than the stated number of whole calendar months separate the two dates, in either direction; a month is complete on the same day number.
- *Reversals:* when that latest service is the only paid or reimbursed one of its kind on its date and has been reversed, nothing blocks. Where there are several on that date, reversing one leaves the benefit blocked.

A blocked line is denied for frequency and nothing is reimbursed for it. The fitting is not limited separately.

**§5 Amounts.** Each reimbursed line receives the lesser of its receipt and its out-of-network amount:

| Line | Out-of-network amount |
|---|---|
| Routine exam | The plan's out-of-network exam amount |
| Fitting | The plan's out-of-network exam amount |
| Lenses | The plan's out-of-network single-vision amount |
| Frame | The plan's out-of-network frame amount |
| Contact lenses certified medically necessary | The plan's out-of-network medically necessary amount |
| Elective contact lenses | The plan's out-of-network elective amount |

Copays are never deducted, and lens options are never reimbursed. The claim's reimbursement is the sum of its reimbursed lines.

**§6 Fitting with contact lenses.** A fitting line follows its claim's contact-lens line. When the contact-lens line receives no reimbursement — its benefit blocked by frequency or missing, its amount 0.00, or the line left out in lieu — the fitting line receives none either and carries the contact-lens line's remark. A fitting on a claim without contact lenses is reimbursed on its own.

**§7 Assembly.** The reimbursement is defined in this order:
1. Each line's amount is taken as the lesser of its receipt and its out-of-network amount, a line denied for frequency or lack of a benefit counting nothing.
2. Contacts-in-lieu keeps or leaves out the contact-lens part and the glasses part.
3. The routine exam line and the kept parts are added.

The reimbursement is booked on the claim's first reimbursed line and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** On a plan with an out-of-network exam amount of 45.00, a single-vision amount of 30.00 and a frame amount of 65.00: receipts are exam 98.00, lenses 74.50 and frame 51.25, with every benefit available. The reimbursement is 45.00 plus 30.00 plus 51.25, which is 126.25.
